    Full translation subquivers #

    graded-category.tex (eq:mesh-object-quotient). Let S be a set of vertices closed under τ and τ⁻¹ wherever defined, and Q_S the full translation subquiver on S. In the path category, killing the identities outside S kills exactly the paths through vertices outside S. A mesh relation based in S retains the terms whose middle vertex lies in S; this is the mesh relation of Q_S.

    This file provides:

    • FullSub S, the full subquiver on S, its inclusion FullSub.incl, and the lift FullSub.liftPath of a path all of whose vertices lie in S;
    • the retraction FullSub.restrict : kQ → kQ_S, sending a path to its lift if it stays in S and to zero otherwise; it is multiplicative;
    • TranslationQuiver.restrict, the translation quiver structure on FullSub S, and the restricted coefficients.
